summary.intent: Group three related pending todos (#5 encrypt share itemName, #8 route shared-folder writes through SDK, #9 remove redundant web folder-seeding) into a single GSD phase, deferring the CRDT-IPNS inbox research todo (#2) that would eventually supersede #5.
summary.outcome: Phase 48 ('SDK self-bootstrap regression fix and shared-folder/metadata consolidation') was created with a P0 prerequisite not in any of the original todos — PR #498's `loadFolder` unconditionally clobbers in-memory state with stale IPNS snapshots, actively regressing main's web-e2e. Phase was committed to a new `phase-48` branch with four planning artifacts.

repo: Phase 47 (PR #494) covered owned-folder SDK consolidation; Phase 48 is the natural successor covering shared-folder writes and share metadata hardening.
web-e2e only triggers automatically on push to main via ci-e2e.yml (workflow_call); it is NOT run on PRs or feature branches — this is the CI gap that allowed PR #498's regression to land undetected.

web-e2e.yml is directly workflow_dispatch-enabled and parameterized by ref (`inputs.ref || github.sha`), so `gh workflow run web-e2e.yml --ref <branch>` provides a pre-merge verification path without any CI changes.
PR #498 introduced self-bootstrap but its `loadFolder` clobbers fresher in-memory folderTree state with a stale IPNS snapshot — same desync class as PR #489.
Todo #9 (remove redundant web folder seeders) was explicitly gated on '#498 proving out in staging/prod'; since #498 is regressing main, #9 cannot safely proceed until the regression is fixed.

The CRDT-IPNS inbox research (#2) would subsume the plaintext share itemName leak (#5/M1) if successful, but cross-linking is the right move — the security finding cannot be held hostage to a long-horizon research prototype.

code.finding: loadFolder performs unconditional folderTree.set(), clobbering fresher in-memory state with a stale IPNS snapshot during self-bootstrap. Fix requires reconciling on sequenceNumber rather than blindly overwriting.

workflow_dispatch trigger exists with `ref: ${{ inputs.ref || github.sha }}` parameter, enabling pre-merge branch validation via `gh workflow run web-e2e.yml --ref <branch>` without requiring a secrets: inherit parent.
push: branches: [main] with paths-filter calls web-e2e via workflow_call — the main-only auto-trigger that created the CI gap allowing #498 to land without pre-merge e2e validation.

workflow: When two todos have a supersession relationship (one long-horizon idea would eliminate the need for a shorter-horizon fix), the right move is cross-linking, not bundling — an open security finding cannot wait on a research prototype.
Parallel code investigation before enriching a phase goal prevents writing requirements against stale premises (here: #9's premise was inverted by the live regression finding).
The GSD pre-merge acceptance gate pattern: bake `gh workflow run <workflow>.yml --ref <fix-branch>` as an explicit verification step in the ROADMAP phase requirement, not just as tribal knowledge.

friction: Stream idle timeout during the parallel fan-out agent investigation, requiring a retry with a simpler serial approach.
PR #498 landed on main without pre-merge web-e2e coverage, causing an active regression that reframed the entire phase scope mid-session.

REQ-2: Remove ~16 web ensureFolderRegistered seeders and duplicate useFolderNavigation key-unwrap — gated on REQ-1 landing and web-e2e passing on the fix branch.
REQ-3: Route shared-folder writes through the SDK client (useSharedWriteOps refactor, medium/multi-PR lift).
REQ-4: Encrypt share itemName at rest with ECIES, mirroring encryptedKey, including column migration.
Todo #2 (CRDT-IPNS inbox for serverless share discovery) explicitly deferred — would subsume REQ-4 if the prototype succeeds, cross-linked in the phase description.
Cargo.lock and .planning/intel/ changes left uncommitted as unrelated to Phase 48.
Phase 48 planning not yet started — next step is `/gsd:plan-phase 48` with REQ-1 as Wave 1.
